usedFor: Pastel collects design feedback on your sites, and Asana receives each new canvas as work through “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Canvases” in Pastel, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A new canvas becomes an Asana task, so review work gets an owner and a date.

watchOut: “New Canvases” is polling, so the task appears after a scheduled check rather than at once.
